title: Savoie's Default Plus
description: My custom resource pack, featuring a lot of little improvements about the game.
body:
Savoie's Default Plus is a resource pack adding multiple improvements to the game.


Features
- Ore Borders 
- Suspicious sand/gravel borders
- Rounded logs textures (including nether trees)
- 3D crops / mushrooms
- 3D piston arm (bedrock-like)
- Bedrock-like beds
- Custom Font
